-- Same as v3, but the date filter now uses an n8n expression instead of
-- a hardcoded string. {{ $today.toISODate() }} evaluates to the current
-- date (YYYY-MM-DD) at runtime, based on your n8n instance's timezone.

select
    region_id,
    region_name,
    telegram_chat_id,
    whatsapp_group_id,
    json_agg(
        json_build_object(
            'product_name', product_name,
            'unit', unit,
            'quantity', total_quantity,
            'value', total_value
        ) order by product_name
    ) as products,
    sum(total_quantity)::float8 as region_total_quantity,
    sum(total_value)::float8 as region_total_value
from (
    select
        o.region_id,
        r.name as region_name,
        r.telegram_chat_id,
        r.whatsapp_group_id,
        o.product_id,
        p.name as product_name,
        p.unit,
        sum(o.quantity)::float8 as total_quantity,
        sum(o.quantity * p.unit_price)::float8 as total_value
    from orders o
    join products p on p.product_id = o.product_id
    join regions r on r.region_id = o.region_id
    where o.status = 'confirmed'
      and to_char(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = '{{ $today.toISODate() }}'
    group by o.region_id, r.name, r.telegram_chat_id, r.whatsapp_group_id, o.product_id, p.name, p.unit
) product_totals
group by region_id, region_name, telegram_chat_id, whatsapp_group_id
order by region_name;

-- Idempotent daily reseed: only inserts ~150 fresh orders for TODAY if
-- none exist yet for today. Safe to run every single day at the start
-- of the workflow, and safe even if the workflow runs multiple times
-- in the same day (won't duplicate or accumulate, unlike the earlier
-- manual version).

with base as (
    select coalesce(max(order_id), 5250) as start_id from orders
),
already_seeded as (
    select exists(select 1 from orders where order_date = current_date) as seeded
)
insert into orders (order_id, order_date, customer_id, region_id, product_id, quantity, status)
select
    base.start_id + gs.i,
    current_date,
    cust_list.customer_id,
    cust_list.region_id,
    prod_list.product_id,
    (1 + (abs(hashtext(gs.i::text || '-qty')) % 15))::numeric,
    case when (abs(hashtext(gs.i::text || '-status')) % 100) < 92 then 'confirmed' else 'cancelled' end
from base,
     already_seeded,
     generate_series(1, 150) as gs(i)
     cross join (select count(*) as n from customers) cust_count
     cross join (select count(*) as n from products) prod_count
     join (select customer_id, region_id, row_number() over (order by customer_id) as rn from customers) cust_list
          on cust_list.rn = 1 + (abs(hashtext(gs.i::text || '-cust')) % cust_count.n)
     join (select product_id, row_number() over (order by product_id) as rn from products) prod_list
          on prod_list.rn = 1 + (abs(hashtext(gs.i::text || '-prod')) % prod_count.n)
where not already_seeded.seeded;
